notes:
Account summary
- Existing Dedicated customer; planning capacity expansion + add second region.
- Primary pain: tail latency instability when long-context summarization jobs run alongside interactive chat.
- Quote from last call: "Our p95 looks great until the nightly summarization wave hits, then chat feels like it’s wading through molasses." (paraphrase)

Firmographics / environment
- Workload mix:
  - Interactive chat (customer-facing agent assist)
  - Long-context summarization (policies/contracts; 16k–64k context windows; batchy overnight + ad hoc during business hours)
  - Some embeddings for doc-search (secondary)
- Current deployment: Dedicated GPU pool w/ VPC peering; customer-managed KMS required; audit logging enabled.
- Regions: currently NA; wants EU add-on for data residency (subset of tenants).

Key requirements (expansion criteria)
- Tail latency stability under mixed workload is the gating requirement.
  - They care about p95 AND p99 for chat routes when summarization is active.
  - They accept slight throughput loss on summarization if it protects chat tail.
- Wants operational levers + visibility:
  - Per-class queue depth + wait time (short vs long)
  - Ability to feature-flag / rollback quickly
  - Written “what we page on” guidance during rollout
- SLO targets (customer-stated, for planning):
  - Chat: p95 < ~900ms end-to-end on their typical prompts; p99 < ~2.5s (they know this will vary by output length; they mostly want stability / no spikes).
  - Summarization: throughput-sensitive, but willing to be deprioritized during interactive hours.

- Internal notes: aligns with mixed-workload scheduler prototype goals (short/long prompt-aware scheduling + guardrails).
